info.name: ProvidusBank - Virtual Payment Service Endpoint
info.description: This end point is created to allow merchants using the ProvidusBank's virtual payment service to be able to update account details as well as generate dynamic account numbers

request.description:
Endpoint update account name; this can be used when a virtual account is re-assigned and there is need to change the name of the account.

#### Expected Sample Response

{
    "requestSuccessful": true,
    "responseMessage": "Successful",
    "responseCode": "00"
}

This method is to create dynamic account number. 

#### Expected Sample Response

{
    "account_number": "9900000001",
    "account_name": "CharlyWize(Adewale)",
    "requestSuccessful": true,
    "responseMessage": "Successful",
    "responseCode": "00",
    "initiationTranRef": "352352352325"
}
This endpoint is to verify a transaction by supplying the session id and credentials.

This endpoint is for blacklisting an account.


#### Expected Sample Response

{
    "requestSuccessful": true,
    "responseMessage": "account blacklisted successfully",
    "responseCode": "00"
}
This service can be used to create static/reserved accounts.
This is the end point to verify transactions by passing the session id
This is an enpoint to verify transactions by passing the settlement id.
